findings.title: XSS Filter Bypass via Unclosed Tag + Double-Slash HTML5 Separator
findings.description: Dalgona XSS Challenge #24. The sanitizer uses a regex `<[^>]+>` to strip closed HTML tags and removes whitespace from input. Bypass: submit an unclosed `` so the regex doesn't match, and the browser closes the tag using `>` from template's ``, creating `` in the DOM.
